opening.t: Old Cartographer's Bluff, Brindle Isle. Sunrise.
There has to be more out there than this.
...Right. Deliveries first. Maren will have my head if I'm late again.

maren_intro.t: Don't tell me you've been staring at the horizon again.
Only a little. The fog lifted off the eastern isles at dawn. You could see three of them.
The parcels won't deliver themselves. Three today.
Spice tins for the Windsong Tavern. A box for Tessa, up at Skywatch Point. And seed packets for the flower terraces by the Cloud Edge.
And Kieran? Stay back from the edge. I mean it.
Door to door, before noon. Courier's honor.

maren_waiting.t: The tavern, Skywatch Point and the Cloud Edge. The parcels are in your satchel, not on the horizon.

maren_return.t: All three? And nobody complained? I'll write that down somewhere.
Here. A morning's wages. Don't spend it all on map paper.
The rest of the day passes the way days on Brindle Isle always do.

maren_deed.t: Kieran. Before you go. This came up from the registry this afternoon.
That's... the deed to Grandpa's workshop.
It's officially yours now. Signed and sealed.
I've lived there half my life. It still feels like it's his.
Your grandfather left you more questions than answers. That seems appropriate.
Go home. The workshop's been waiting long enough.

maren_after.t: Go home, Kieran. And get some sleep. You look like you've been reading weather logs again.

tavern_deliver.t: Spice tins, from the Post House.
Half the folk in here will tell you the Skyfarers were a bedtime story. Your grandfather never once let them finish that argument.

tavern_after.t: That's what people say right before the weather changes, you know. 'Another clear day.'

tessa_deliver.t: You climbed all the way up here? You could have left it at the bottom of the steps.
Look, though. You can see the eastern isles from up here. Grandpa used to say some of them move.
Islands don't move, Kieran. The registry has had the same charts for two hundred years.
One day you're going to disappear chasing one of those stories.
Then I'll send you a postcard.

tessa_after.t: Skywatch logs say clear skies all week. No moving islands. I checked.

villager_deliver.t: The seed packets! Just in time for planting. Mind your step out here.
Below the terraces, the sea of clouds rolls on toward the horizon.
You ever wonder if we're all just looking in the wrong direction?
Every day. Then I get back to work.

villager_after.t: Elias used to sit right there on the wall with his notebook. Said the wind out here talks if you listen.

board.t: 'LOST: one copper kettle. Last seen near the fountain. Reward: soup.'
'SKYWATCH POINT reports: clear skies, steady winds. Traders expected from the north at month's end.'
'Storytelling night at the Windsong Tavern. No Skyfarer stories, please. — R. Finch, Village Elder'

fountain.t: The fountain's older than the village. Grandpa said the carvings on the basin aren't decorations. They're wind charts.

windmill.t: The Whispermill sails never stop turning. Strong steady wind, every day of the year.

workshop_locked_ch1.t: Home. The deliveries come first, though.

edge_warning.t: That's a long way down. Even I'm not that curious. Yet.

skywatch_hint.t: Skywatch Point is up on the ridge. The quickest way is over the market stalls and up the old scaffolding.
